title: Running the Workflow: commands, environment, the fleet job and posting
summary: Source bin/workflow_env.sh from the repository root; it sets REXX_PATH (the Workflow, ooRexx Logging v0.7, crypto v0.8.3, runtime reference v0.4, the Foreign Runtime, Body Slam, the Rexx/SQL backend and the browser UI kit's MailboxClient) and LD_LIBRARY_PATH. KitRun also needs REXXSQL_LIBDIR (a directory with librexxsql.so) set before sourcing, and a Body Slam database (--db). Commands: steps, plan PKGDIR, run PKGDIR, survey LIST, post. Output goes under --work (default /tmp/alchemy_workflow): out/workflow.log, out/receipts, out/ledger.words, out/outbox. tools/wf_fleet_job.rex runs the whole shadow survey on a build host with no setup by hand: it checks and builds the kit, reads the checkout into a fresh Body Slam database and writes FLEET_RESULT.txt. tools/wf_sphere_seal.rex fills a sphere's provenance hashes and manifest. post sends every report waiting in out/outbox through MailboxClient with a mode-600 token file; the token never appears on a command line or in a log.
invariants: Exit codes: 0 PASS or FIXED, 1 WARN, 3 FAIL, 4 a step broke (ERROR), 2 usage.
post refuses to run without a URL, a principal and a token file of mode 600 or 400 holding one word.

A report that posts moves to out/outbox/sent with a .posted file (request id, time, principal, nudge); one that does not stays with a .error file and is tried again next time. Nothing is posted twice.
The fleet job changes nothing in the checkout except building libforeign_runtime.so when it is missing.
